Decrypt secrets.toml.enc with the age identity in DRT_SECRETS_KEY.

## Usage

```bash
drt decrypt [OPTIONS] PATH
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATH` | yes | Path to an encrypted secrets.toml.enc file. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Replace an existing plaintext file. |
